headline: Oil: Houthis Reignite Concerns in the Middle East – Prices Rise
summary: Oil prices recovered on Wednesday after Houthi rebels claimed they struck a Saudi oil tanker in the Red Sea. Brent crude was trending upward at midday.
why: Brent is the international benchmark for crude oil prices, and Red Sea shipping disruptions affect global oil transport costs and supply.
why_moved: Houthi rebels claimed a strike on a Saudi oil tanker in the Red Sea, reigniting supply concerns in the Middle East, and prices recovered on the news.
